DataGrid

A spreadsheet-like grid — one tab stop, arrow keys between cells, Enter to edit, row and range selection, virtualized rows — for data people work in rather than read. Table's `role=grid` sibling, sharing its column and data model.

Basic usage

Install the package:

pnpm add @design-schema/react

Import the stylesheet once for the app, then the component:

import '@design-schema/react/index.css';
import { DataGrid } from '@design-schema/react';

import { DataGrid, type DataGridColumn, type DataGridRow } from '@design-schema/react';

interface Product extends DataGridRow {
  name: string;
  category: string;
  qty: number;
  price: number;
  active: boolean;
}

const DATA: Product[] = [
  { id: 'sku-1001', name: 'Aster desk lamp', category: 'Lighting', qty: 42, price: 39.0, active: true },
  { id: 'sku-1002', name: 'Bramble side table', category: 'Furniture', qty: 8, price: 129.0, active: true },
  { id: 'sku-1003', name: 'Cedar wall clock', category: 'Decor', qty: 15, price: 54.5, active: false },
  { id: 'sku-1004', name: 'Driftwood shelf', category: 'Furniture', qty: 23, price: 89.0, active: true },
  { id: 'sku-1005', name: 'Ember candle set', category: 'Decor', qty: 60, price: 24.0, active: true },
];

const CATEGORY_OPTIONS = [
  { value: 'Lighting', label: 'Lighting' },
  { value: 'Furniture', label: 'Furniture' },
  { value: 'Decor', label: 'Decor' },
];

const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', isRowHeader: true, width: 200, resizable: true },
  { key: 'category', header: 'Category', width: 160, editable: true, editor: 'select', options: CATEGORY_OPTIONS },
  {
    key: 'qty',
    header: 'Qty',
    align: 'end',
    width: 100,
    sortable: true,
    editable: true,
    editor: 'number',
    validate: (value) => (typeof value === 'number' && value >= 0 ? undefined : 'Qty must be zero or more.'),
  },
  {
    key: 'price',
    header: 'Price (USD)',
    abbr: 'Price',
    align: 'end',
    width: 140,
    sortable: true,
    editable: true,
    editor: 'number',
    render: (row) => `$${(row as Product).price.toFixed(2)}`,
  },
];

<DataGrid caption="Price list" columns={COLUMNS} data={DATA} />
16 rows

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescriptionPlatforms
caption requiredstring—

What the grid holds ("Price list"). The accessible name; visually hidden with `hideCaption`.

Accessibility: aria-labelledby the caption (web) / accessibilityLabel (native).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
hideCaptionbooleanfalse

Visually hide the caption; it remains the accessible name.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
columns requiredarray { key: string; header: string; abbr?: string; align?: "start" | "end" | "center"; sortable?: boolean; width?: number; minWidth?: number; resizable?: boolean; isRowHeader?: boolean; pinned?: "start" | "end"; editable?: boolean; editor?: "text" | "number" | "select" | "date" | "checkbox"; options?: { value: string; label: string }[]; render?: (row: Row) => ReactNode; validate?: (value: unknown, row: Row) => string | undefined }[]—

Table's column model plus grid concerns: pixel `width` (columns do not auto-size in a virtualized grid; `width` is a multiple of space.1, e.g. 160; 160 when omitted, `literal-ok`), `resizable` (pointer drag on the header edge, Shift+ArrowLeft/Right on the header cell by `resizeStep`), `pinned` columns that stay put while scrolling sideways (pinned columns must be contiguous at the start or end of `columns`; the selection column is always pinned start and counted in the offsets), `editable` with an `editor` kind and `validate`. Exactly one column may be `isRowHeader`.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
data requiredarray Row[] where Row = { id: string; [key: string]: unknown }—

The rows. `id` must be stable. Large arrays are fine; only visible rows are rendered.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
rowCountnumber—

Total rows when `data` is a window of a larger set (server paging). Sets aria-rowcount; `onRangeNeeded` asks for more. `data` is always a contiguous prefix of the full set starting at row 0 and only grows by appending; keyboard navigation is clamped to loaded rows.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
sortobject { column: string; direction: "ascending" | "descending" }—

Controlled sort state; as Table.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
defaultSortobject { column: string; direction: "ascending" | "descending" }—

Initial sort; the grid sorts `data` itself when `rowCount` is not set.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
selectablenone | row | cell | rangenone

`row` adds a checkbox column and Shift/Ctrl row selection; `cell` selects the focused cell (selection follows focus, no key needed); `range` allows Shift+arrow / pointer-drag rectangles (copy as TSV). Selection is separate from focus in row and range mode: focus is where the keyboard is, selection is what an action applies to.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
selectedarray string[]—

Controlled selected row ids (row mode).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
editablebooleanfalse

Master switch: cells whose column is `editable` can be edited with Enter, F2, typing, or double-click. Off by default so a grid is read-only unless meant to be edited.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
densitycompact | comfortablecompact

Row height: compact suits the grid's purpose; comfortable for touch.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
stickyHeaderbooleantrue

The header stays visible while the body scrolls. Always true when virtualized.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
heightcontent | viewport | fixedviewport

`viewport` sets the grid height to `100vh − 2 × layout.gap.section`, as Table (the grid, not the page, scrolls); `content` grows with rows (no virtualization, small grids); `fixed` uses a height the caller sets through `overrides.fixedHeight` — one of the few size bindings that is overridable by design.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
loadingbooleanfalse

Sets aria-busy and shows `copy.loading` in the status bar; existing rows stay.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
emptyMessagestring—

Shown when `data` is empty.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
showStatusBarbooleantrue

A footer line with row count, selection count and, while editing, the validation message — the visible counterpart of the live region.

web, lit, rn, swiftui

Events

EventTypeDescriptionPlatforms
onSortChangeonSortChange / sort-change

As Table.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
onSelectionChangeonSelectionChange / selection-change

Fired with the selection: row ids, one cell `{ rowId, column }`, or a range `{ from, to }`.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
onCellChangeonCellChange / cell-change

Fired when an edit commits, with `{ rowId, column, value, previous }`. The caller updates `data`; the grid shows the old value until it does (a rejected edit reverts visibly).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
onEditStartonEditStart / edit-start

Fired when an editor opens; return false (web) or call preventDefault (lit) to refuse editing that cell.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
onRangeNeededonRangeNeeded / range-needed / onEndReached

Fired when the visible window (or Ctrl+End / PageDown) comes within one page of the end of `data` and `rowCount` says there is more, with `{ start, end }` row indexes to load; fired once per `end` until `data` grows.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
onColumnResizeonColumnResize / column-resize

Fired with `{ column, width }` when the user finishes dragging a resizable column edge.

web, lit, rn, swiftui

Accessibility

Decisions this component leaves to you

Supply an accessible name. This component has no text of its own to fall back on, so without one a screen reader announces its role and nothing else.

Required props that carry accessibility meaning: caption. Each is described in the props table above.

Implicit ARIA role: grid.

Anatomy

containerscrollRegiongridcaptionheaderheaderRowcolumnHeadersortButtonbodyrowrowHeadercellcellContenteditorselectCellselectAllCellrangeOverlayemptyStatestatusBar

What generation guarantees

Accessible name — Every instance carries a programmatic name. Where the component has no text of its own to use, the name is a prop the consumer supplies.

Keyboard operable — Everything the pointer can do here, the keyboard can do — see the keyboard section.

Arrow navigation — Arrow keys move between items; Home and End jump to the ends.

Roving tabindex — The group is a single tab stop; the arrow keys move within it.

Visible focus — Keyboard focus is always drawn, from the theme’s focus tokens, and is never removed.

Selected state — Selection is exposed programmatically (`aria-selected` / `aria-checked`).

Live region — Changes are announced through a live region, without moving focus.

Contrast — Text and meaningful non-text contrast meets WCAG AA; the pairs are listed below.

Target size — Interactive targets are at least 24×24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.2 Target Size, minimum).

No hover-only content — Nothing is reachable by hover alone; keyboard focus reveals the same content.

Escape dismisses — Escape closes it from anywhere inside.

18 rows

DataGrid keyboard support

KeyAction
TabEnters the grid on the last-focused cell (initially the first header cell) and, from inside, leaves it — the grid is one tab stop. Inside a cell that contains a control, Tab still leaves the grid; use Enter to interact with the control. While an editor is open, Tab commits and opens the next editable cell in the row (Shift+Tab the previous); from the last editable cell it commits and leaves the grid.
ArrowRightNext cell in the row.
ArrowLeftPrevious cell.
ArrowDownSame column, next row (into the body from the header).
ArrowUpSame column, previous row (into the header from the first body row).
HomeFirst cell in the row (Ctrl: first cell in the grid).
EndLast cell in the row (Ctrl: last cell in the grid).
PageDownDown one visible page of rows, same column.
PageUpUp one visible page of rows.
EnterOn a header cell: sorts (if sortable). On an editable cell: opens the editor; while editing, commits and moves focus down one row. On the selection cell: toggles its checkbox. On a cell whose `render` contains a control (Link, Button, Checkbox): focuses and activates the first focusable descendant.
F2Opens the editor without moving; while editing, commits and returns focus to the cell without moving.
EscapeWhile editing, cancels the edit and restores the value. Otherwise clears a range selection.
SpaceRow mode: toggles the focused row; Shift+Space extends the row selection from the anchor (the last row toggled) through the focused row. Range mode: selects the focused row as a full-width range, Shift+Space extends that row range, Ctrl+Space selects the focused column as a range over the loaded rows. (selectable is row or range)
Shift+ArrowRight or Shift+ArrowLeft or Shift+ArrowDown or Shift+ArrowUpExtends the range selection from the anchor; a plain arrow collapses the range to the newly focused cell and makes it the anchor. (selectable is range and focus in the body)
Shift+ArrowRight or Shift+ArrowLeftWidens / narrows the column by resizeStep and fires onColumnResize on release of Shift. (focus on the header cell of a resizable column)
Control+aSelects all loaded rows or cells (bound by key code KeyA, so it works on any layout). (selectable is row or range)
Control+cCopies the selection as tab-separated text (with headers when whole columns are selected); bound by key code KeyC. (selectable is range)
Delete or BackspaceClears the value of editable cells in the selection. (editable and selection)
